<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="kSmsmG8-0ak7YWJ78IUT"> <mxGraphModel dx="1239" dy="2011" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
left to right direction

skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam nodesep 25
skinparam ranksep 25
skinparam defaultFontSize 12

actor Visitante as V
actor Corretor as C
actor Administrador as A
actor ViaCEP as CEP
actor Nominatim as NOM

rectangle \"Sistema Imobiliário\" {

 package \"Consulta pública\" {
 usecase \"Consultar imóveis\" as UC1
 usecase \"Filtrar imóveis\" as UC2
 usecase \"Ver detalhes\" as UC3
 usecase \"Ver mapa\" as UC4
 }

 package \"Área administrativa\" {
 usecase \"Login\" as UC5
 usecase \"Validar 2FA\" as UC6
 usecase \"Configurar 2FA\" as UC7
 usecase \"Logout\" as UC8

 usecase \"Cadastrar imóvel\" as UC9
 usecase \"Editar imóvel\" as UC10
 usecase \"Excluir imóvel\" as UC11
 usecase \"Gerenciar imagens\" as UC12
 usecase \"Alterar disponibilidade\" as UC13

 usecase \"Consultar CEP\" as UC14
 usecase \"Geocodificar endereço\" as UC15
 }
}

C --|> A

V --> UC1
V --> UC2
V --> UC3
V --> UC4

A --> UC5
A --> UC7
A --> UC8
A --> UC9
A --> UC10
A --> UC11
A --> UC12
A --> UC13

UC5 ..> UC6 : <<include>>
UC9 ..> UC14 : <<include>>
UC10 ..> UC14 : <<include>>
UC9 ..> UC15 : <<include>>
UC10 ..> UC15 : <<include>>

CEP --> UC14
NOM --> UC15

@enduml
",
